title: Bring your people
summary: A sheet that asks a new member for up to 4 people from their family, one slot at a time (bipe-chat/bipe#752). Each filled slot is a personal invite with that person's name; the system share sheet sends its link. Slots show the state of each invite: sent, joined or expired.

inviteId.description: The personal invite of this slot. Absent for an empty slot.

name.description: Who the slot is for (Invite.name). Required before the invite is made.

status.description: empty: bipe_bring_people_slot_empty. editing: the name field and bipe_first_card_invite_action. sent: pending invite, bipe_bring_people_sent. joined: bipe_bring_people_joined, the row opens the DM. expired: bipe_bring_people_expired, the row offers bipe_bring_people_expired_action.

slots.description: Exactly registries/onboarding.json bringPeople.slots slots (4), filled slots first in the order they were filled.

available.description: MyInvites.available. Empty slots beyond it stay hidden; at 0 the sheet shows bipe_invites_none_left and bipe_invites_next. Absent while loading.

phase.description: creating: one slot's invite is being made (bipe_app_invite_creating on that slot). failed: bipe_error_network with bipe_app_retry, or bipe_error_invite_quota.

appear.effect: GET /v1/me/invites. Fills the slots from the invite ids this phone keeps for this flow, and updates each slot status from the invite status.

editSlot.effect: Opens the name field on that slot, with bipe_bring_people_name_placeholder. One slot edits at a time.

invite.effect: POST /v1/me/invites, then PUT /v1/me/invites/{inviteId} with the name. Keeps the link and the invite id on this phone for this flow. Opens the system share sheet with bipe_invites_share_message and the link. The slot becomes sent whether or not the share sheet sent it. A retry never repeats POST.

openJoined.effect: Opens the DM with the person who joined (Client.getDmRoom).

resend.effect: Opens the system share sheet again with the same link. An invite made on another phone has no link here: opens invites, where its row opens invite-qr.

replaceExpired.effect: Makes a new invite with the same name, as invite, in the same slot.

done.effect: Closes the sheet. Counts as an answer, not a decline.

notNow.effect: Closes the sheet and adds one decline (bringPeople.stopAfterDeclines). Shown only while no slot is filled.

notes: Decisions (MZ, 26 October 2026, bipe-chat/bipe#752): up to 4 named people, family first (ADR 0047), at most one follow-up ask per week, stop after two declines, success is the days from sign-up to the fifth contact.

When it opens: the first time Conversas shows after signup-done, that is after the person leaves the inviter's chat. Never before the first message (the 60-second target in docs/onboarding.md), and never over another sheet: after the notifications prompt when both are due. The first-list invite card (chat-list-cards shareInvite) opens this sheet too.

Registry to add in the build (generate, never copy, ADR 0031): registries/onboarding.json bringPeople { slots: 4, firstCircle: "family", followUpEveryDays: 7, pendingAfterDays: 3, stopAfterDeclines: 2 }, the prompt key bringPeople with trigger firstChatListAfterSignup and target bringPeopleSheet, and the prompt key bringPeopleReminder with trigger bringPeopleDue (spec bring-people-reminder). gen-onboarding.mjs gets the new triggers and targets; the schedule rule goes in tools/lib/registries.mjs with test vectors, like pinReminderNext.

Each slot is one personal invite from the normal quota (INVITES_PER_USER, 10 today). The flow makes no bulk send, reads no address book and sends no message to a person who did not start a chat (security rule 11).
The name stays on the server as Invite.name, seen only by the user, as in invite-note. The invite ids of this flow are kept on this phone per account; the slots of another phone start empty.
Out of scope: a reward per invite (it makes spam), group asks (waits for joining a group by link), and any text that names a party or a politician (strategy principle 1).
